title: ISO 14691:2008 — Petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries — Flexible couplings for mechanical power transmission — General purpose
locator: Official catalogue scope and abstract; general-purpose flexible couplings for petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries; design, materials, inspection and testing scope
notes: This is a sector-specific standard for petroleum, petrochemical and natural gas industries, not a general machine-tool coupling selection or acceptance standard. The catalogue states that selection criteria are not defined; applicability to a specific machine-tool application requires a separate engineering basis. Standard full text is not archived.
